summary.name: Mockoon
summary.one_liner: Mockoon is a free, open-source tool for designing and running mock REST APIs locally, with a desktop app, a CLI, and a Docker image.
use_cases: Let frontend teams build against mock APIs before the backend is ready
Avoid third-party API quotas and rate limits during development
Run mock servers headlessly in CI/CD pipelines
Simulate errors, timeouts and rate limits for testing
Record live API traffic and generate mock routes from it
summary.what_it_does: Mockoon lets you define mock REST endpoints with HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), response codes and dynamic JSON responses using templating helpers and Faker.js. You can define multiple responses per route and select them with rules matching headers, query parameters, body payloads or cookies. It can forward requests to real APIs, record them, and generate mock routes from live traffic. The lightweight CLI and official Docker image run mock servers headlessly in CI/CD and local test suites.
notable: Open-source core with no account required and no cloud dependency
Lightweight CLI and official Docker image for headless CI/CD mocks
Rules-based responses matching headers, query params, body or cookies
Record and forward to real APIs to generate mock routes from live traffic
caveats: Team collaboration, data synchronization and hosted deployments require Mockoon Pro, which is in beta and self-hosted
Pricing details for Mockoon Pro are not stated on the page
